intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Four, one of the crew who resist Kaladin's efforts to take charge of them.
A former bridgeman of Bridge Four, freed into Dalinar Kholin's army.
A member of Bridge Four and one of its first men to become a Windrunner squire, trained to draw in Stormlight.
A member of Bridge Four and a Windrunner.

items.text: Peet was one of the Bridge Four men who stubbornly resisted Kaladin taking charge, though he fetched Kaladin a waterskin while he treated Leyten on a bridge run. Soon after, Peet and Narm were wounded, adding to the injured bridgemen who needed food but drew no pay.
Once healed, Peet rejoined the bridge carrying. When the crew gave Rock a razor in thanks for his nightly stew, Peet pointed out the other gifts with it: a steel mirror, soap and a strop.

When the new captain, Hashal, put Bridge Four on chasm duty permanently, a worried Peet asked Kaladin what they would do. In the chasms Kaladin offered to train them with spears for an escape, and they all agreed.
After training in the chasms, Peet went with Bridge Four on the joint assault of Dalinar and Sadeas at the Tower. When Sadeas betrayed Dalinar, Kaladin had Rock and Peet help the wounded Teft along.
Bridge Four could have escaped, but the men backed Kaladin's decision to go back and help Dalinar. Peet was stunned to see Kaladin take on the Parshendi alone at the far end of their bridge.

Dalinar traded his Shardblade for the lives of Sadeas's bridgemen and took them into his army. That night Kaladin showed the men he could breathe in Stormlight, and when Rock joked about throwing him off a cliff, Peet missed the joke and asked what good that would do.

Bridge Four became guards for the Kholins and trained the other bridgemen as soldiers. On free evenings Peet met Ka, a barmaid at the Ornery Chull, and took an interest in her; when Kaladin came along, Peet got them a table thanks to her, and left the conversation to help her clear tables.
Peet was on duty in Adolin's staging room on the day of his duel against Elit, and saw Adolin agree to fight Relis and whoever he chose to bring.

Bridge Four went with Dalinar on the expedition that ended in the Battle of Narak. Peet went with Shallan to explore the plateau that proved to be an Oathgate, and ran back to tell Dalinar the armies had to get onto it. After Shallan took them to Urithiru, Peet and the other surviving bridgemen returned to the Shattered Plains to wait for Kaladin.
Exploring Urithiru's tunnels, Bridge Four found Sadeas's corpse, and Peet noted that Vedekar Perel's body looked just like it. He and Leyten found Oathbringer in a planter and brought it to Dalinar.
Peet and Ka became betrothed, prompting Sigzil to raise with Kaladin, once again, the need for housing for married bridgemen.

As one of Bridge Four's first squires, Peet taught recruits to breathe in Stormlight and led the newest squires, including Lyn and Colot, in practising Lashings. He and Drehy helped Hobber stand for the first time after Hobber healed his legs.
Peet went with Dalinar to Thaylen City. Back at the barracks, Bridge Four found Rock and Bisig injured and Eth dead. Peet tended Bisig and suggested Renarin treat Rock.
Bridge Four followed Teft through the Oathgate into the Battle of Thaylen Field. Afterwards, at Taravangian's request, Teft, Leyten and Peet flew a platform of wounded towards the upper city.

After the battle at Thaylen City, Peet bonded a spren of his own. After Kaladin stepped back from fighting, Peet and most of the Bridge Four Windrunners joined Dalinar's forces in Emul. After the occupation of Urithiru he returned for Teft's funeral with the rest of Bridge Four.

appearance.text: Peet is lean and balding, with an oval face.

personality.text: Others see Peet as quietly dependable.
